description: The image consists of three side-by-side horizontal bar charts illustrating the performance of various long-context language models across three distinct evaluation categories: "Understanding", "Reasoning", and "Trustworthiness". The shared vertical axis on the left contains the categorical labels representing different language models, ordered from top to bottom based on their descending performance in the "Understanding" chart. The bottom-most label on this axis is obscured by a solid grey rectangle. Each of the three charts has its own horizontal value axis representing a linear percentage scale; the "Understanding" and "Trustworthiness" axes range from 0% to 100% with tick marks at 20% intervals, while the "Reasoning" axis ranges from 0% to 70% with tick marks at 10% intervals. Each category features a single horizontal bar in each of the three subplots, with the exact numeric value annotated at the end of every bar. The majority of the bars are colored in a standard medium blue, while the bars corresponding to "gpt-4o-2024-11-20", "gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18", and "gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14" are visually emphasized in a brighter, darker blue across all three charts. In the "Understanding" chart, values range from a high of 98.0 for "gpt-4o-2024-11-20" down to 2.4 for the obscured bottom category. In the "Reasoning" chart, values vary, with the highest being 66.5 for "gpt-4o-2024-11-20" and the lowest being 6.8 for "Phi-3-medium-128k-instruct". In the "Trustworthiness" chart, values range from a high of 88.8 for "gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18" to a low of 0.0 for the obscured bottom category. Horizontal dashed gridlines run across the charts to separate the categories.
